hero.title: We build what the roadmap prescribes.
hero.subtitle: AI automations, API integrations, and custom systems — executed by the same team that diagnosed the problem.
hero.intro: Having a plan transforms nothing. Transformation happens when someone builds. We implement the initiatives prioritized by the audit and the roadmap: AI agents, operational automations, system integrations, dashboards, and custom software — with no hand-offs between who designed the solution and who builds it.

problem.title: When do you need Implementation?
problem.subtitle: The service starts when you already know what to solve and need a team that builds it well.
items: You have an approved roadmap and no one internally can execute it on time
You want to automate critical processes without hiring and onboarding a new team
You need to integrate SaaS and internal systems without building an in-house IT department
You've tried AI agencies and only got pretty demos — nothing in production
Your IT team is buried in maintenance and can't take on new projects

deliverables.title: What we build
deliverables.subtitle: Real capabilities, not labels. Every block delivers value in production.

items.title: AI automations
items.body: Agents and workflows with n8n, LangChain, multi-agent setups, and OpenAI/Anthropic models. Real use cases, not demos.

items.title: API-first integrations
items.body: We connect PMS, CRM, ERP, marketplaces, billing tools, helpdesks, and internal SaaS. APIs, webhooks, queues, ETL.

items.title: WhatsApp and omnichannel bots
items.body: Customer service, booking, support, and acquisition bots with WhatsApp Business API, Telegram, and CRM integration.

items.title: Operational dashboards
items.body: Consolidated operational and financial metrics. Data from multiple sources in a panel that answers the real questions.

items.title: Custom systems
items.body: Internal apps, customer portals, admin panels, and internal tools when no SaaS fits.

items.title: Support and evolution
items.body: Maintenance, monitoring, and continuous improvements on a retainer model. Automation isn't built and forgotten — it evolves.

methodology.title: Execution without hand-offs
methodology.subtitle: Same team from discovery through production. Short iterations, fast decisions, every block ships.

phases.title: Technical discovery
phases.body: We validate requirements, accesses, data, and constraints. We define concrete architecture and a sprint plan.

phases.title: Iterative build
phases.body: 1–2 week sprints with functional deliveries. Your team tests each block in its own environment before promotion.

phases.title: Controlled deployment
phases.body: We promote to production with active monitoring. Documented rollback plan, observability from day one.

phases.title: Continuous evolution
phases.body: Monthly retainer or one-off sprints. We resolve incidents, tune models, integrate new sources, and scale.

audience.title: Engagement models
audience.subtitle: We adapt the model to the size of the problem.
items: Fixed-scope project: fixed scope, fixed budget, defined timeline — ideal for concrete initiatives with clear scope
Monthly retainer: dedicated team with reserved capacity — ideal for multi-month roadmaps with shifting priorities
Support and evolution: post go-live monitoring, improvements, and new use cases on top of what's built
Embedded squad: our team works alongside yours in shared tools and processes

pricing.title: From €3,000 / month
pricing.subtitle: Monthly retainer between €3,000–€8,000/month based on reserved capacity. Fixed-scope projects priced by scope.
items: Senior AI and development team — no junior masking, no hidden outsourcing
Direct team access on Slack/WhatsApp — no account manager middleman
Bi-weekly reports with progress, risks, and pending decisions

items.q: Do I need to have done the X-Ray or Roadmap first?
items.a: No, but it helps. If you arrive with a clear roadmap, we execute. If you arrive with a concrete problem, we run a brief technical Discovery before planning the implementation.

items.q: Do you work with the technology we already use?
items.a: Yes. We don't push vendor lock-in. If your CRM, ERP, or PMS works, we integrate. If it's broken, we say so before building on top.
The client. Repositories in your organization, documentation included, no hidden dependencies on our systems.
Two options: we run a support and evolution retainer, or we transfer to your team with documentation and a technical handover.
Both. Mid-market reality mixes modern SaaS with legacy systems. We build clean integrations between both without rewriting what doesn't need to be touched.

items.q: How fast is the first delivery?
items.a: Typically 2–4 weeks from kick-off. Every sprint ships something functional. If you don't see value in the first month, something failed — and we fix it.

finalCta.title: Have a concrete project or an approved roadmap?
finalCta.subtitle: 30-minute call to understand scope and constraints. If there's a fit, implementation proposal in 48–72h.
